amazfit-health-log 1.0.0 (initial release)

- Automatically fetches daily health data from an Amazfit GTR3 via HCGateway.
- Writes a structured Obsidian note summarizing steps, sleep, heart rate, SpO2, and distance.
- Supports triggering by user command or daily cron (default 06:00).
- Includes troubleshooting steps and detailed output format.
- Requires running HCGateway containers and pre-configured credentials.
